offering_description.value: Develops and sells software for product design, product lifecycle management, application lifecycle management, service lifecycle management and industrial IoT/augmented reality. Customers are mainly manufacturers, who license it as subscriptions, sold largely through a reseller network and direct sales.

primary_products.value: CAD software; product lifecycle management software; application lifecycle management software; service lifecycle management software; industrial IoT and augmented reality software

primary_services.value: consulting and implementation; training; technical support; maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: Discrete manufacturers in aerospace, automotive, electronics, medical devices and industrial equipment

end_markets.value: industrial machinery; automotive; aerospace and defense; electronics and high tech; medical devices

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring software subscriptions for design, PLM, ALM and SLM tools; licensing or royalties: perpetual software licenses and related support contracts; service fees: consulting, implementation, training and technical support
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops in-house engineering software platforms sold to manufacturers and engineering firms

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: CAD, PLM, ALM, SLM and industrial IoT/AR software for product-centric manufacturers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team serving large enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: value-added reseller network, especially for CAD and mid-market customers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business, data privacy and export control rules apply to software
